author: Sarah M.
text: The whole day ran like clockwork. Our guide knew exactly when to beat the crowds at the falls and the boat ride was the highlight of our trip.

author: James T.
text: Picked up at 55 York St and back in time for dinner. Small group, no queues and a guide who actually made the drive interesting.

author: Priya K.
text: Great value for a full day out. The free time in Niagara-on-the-Lake was a little short, but the cruise and the guide more than made up for it.

author: Daniel R.
text: Booked the private tour for our anniversary and had the day to ourselves. Watching the falls from the Parkway with nobody rushing us was unforgettable.

author: Emma L.
text: The maple syrup tasting was a lovely surprise and the driver-guide really knew the region. Easily the best day of our two weeks in Ontario.

author: Marc G.
text: Comfortable bus and a friendly driver. The itinerary was well paced, though we would have liked more time at the whirlpool.

author: Olivia P.
text: Took my parents for their first trip to the falls. Pickup was on time, everything was organised and the guide was patient with my dad’s questions.

author: Noah W.
text: The day was relaxed and never felt rushed. The stops along the Niagara Parkway were well chosen, which made the price feel good value.
